route.instructions: Choose the smallest appropriate handling path for this support ticket. Use only the supplied issue summary, product area, customer impact and stated urgency.

criteria.urgent_human: Material outage, security concern, payment lockout, or explicit severe business impact that needs prompt human review.
criteria.standard_queue: Legitimate support request that needs a normal support workflow but is not urgent.
criteria.self_serve: Clearly informational or already answered by the supplied known-resolution context.
